question: A right prism has a regular pentagonal base of side length 7 cm and height 16 cm. Find the lateral surface area.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Perimeter of a regular pentagonal base = 5 × side = 5 × 7 = 35 cm.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of a prism = Perimeter of base × Height.

LSA = 35 × 16 = 560 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 560 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the regular pentagonal base (s) = 7 cm

Height of the right prism (h) = 16 cm

**Formula Used:**

Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter of base × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da619097cf23840cca9f076d0d4f9a8c4e3be05126c87286b1fd703eb9a7db6b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Perimeter of the pentagonal base = 5 × side

⇒ Perimeter = 5 × 7 = 35 cm

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 35 × 16

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 560 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 560 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Prism

TSA = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × Area of the base.

Volume of a Prism

Volume = Area of the base × Height of the prism.

Area of a Regular Pentagon

Area = (1/4) × √(5(5 + 2√5)) × s², where s is the side length.</p
